title: AL Ruleset
description: Schema for *.ruleset.json — diagnostic severity overrides for AL code analyzers

description.description: Description of the ruleset; useful to document its purpose.

generalAction.description: Action applied to all diagnostics with a rule that has a Default action specified, and to diagnostics from the current analyzers that have no rule defined. A stricter generalAction from an included file is used.

enableExternalRulesets.description: Controls whether an external ruleset pointed to by the al.ruleSetPath setting is used.

includedRuleSets.description: List of external ruleset files to include. The processing order is undefined.

path.description: Path to the included file. Relative to the project folder (al.ruleSetPath root) or to the including file.

action.description: Action applied to diagnostics from the included ruleset whose action differs from None and Hidden.

rules.description: Collection of rules applied to diagnostics generated by analyzers.

id.description: The string that uniquely identifies a diagnostic (e.g. AA0001, AS0072).

action.description: Action applied when the diagnostic is emitted.
